title: Card that stacks on phones
summary: A row of image and text that switches to a column below 520px, with one media query changing flex-direction.
explanation: On wide screens the card is a row: the image keeps its size with flex-shrink: 0, and the text takes the rest with flex: 1. align-items: center keeps the image vertically centred against the text.

Below 520px a single media query switches flex-direction to column. The image now sits above the text, and align-items: stretch lets the text use the full card width. Nothing else in the markup changes.
tryThis: Narrow the preview below 520px and watch the card stack.
Remove flex-shrink: 0 from .thumb and narrow the preview: the image squeezes.
Change align-items to flex-start on the wide layout: the image sits at the top of the text instead of its middle.
